title: feat: add shared account menu
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds a reusable account menu for name, avatar, and sign-out actions.
- Supports opening dropdowns above or below their trigger.
- Keeps authentication and admin policy outside the UI component.

Tests: `npm run typecheck --prefix packages/ui`, `npm test --prefix packages/ui`, `npm run build --prefix packages/ui`

gist.headline: One menu, many hives
gist.blurb: A reusable little account perch has landed: name, avatar, and sign-out now live in one tidy menu. It can bloom upward or downward depending on where the screen has room.
gist.summary: Added a reusable AccountMenu component to packages/ui with avatar, display name, sign-out actions, and configurable above-or-below dropdown placement while keeping authentication and admin policy outside the component.
gist.impact: Apps using the shared UI package can give people a consistent account menu without rebuilding account controls or coupling their auth rules to the interface.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli tending a compact garden kiosk shaped like an account menu, with a friendly avatar portrait, name plaque, and a tiny sign-out door. The menu has two possible blooming positions above and below a retro terminal trigger, making the placement behavior visible; add small code-plants to represent the reusable UI component.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny gardener apron, arranging a friendly account-menu flower kiosk beside a retro terminal; the kiosk shows a small avatar, a name tag, and a tiny "SIGN OUT" door, with matching dropdown panels blooming above and below its trigger.
